name: CERN Summer Student Programme
dlText: Expected late Jan 2027 · form opens in November
tags: Must still be enrolled at start

countryNotes.PK: Pakistan is a CERN Associate Member State, so use the Member/Associate track.

note: For BSc/MSc students (not PhD) in physics, engineering, CS or maths. Applications usually open in November and close at the end of January. Students from non-member states can apply too (funded via the CERN & Society Foundation).

name: DAAD RISE Germany
amount: Monthly stipend for 3 months (amount: check official page)
dlText: 15 Oct – 30 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET · references by 15 Dec
tags: Must study at a US/Canada/UK/Ireland university (12+ months)
note: Open to undergraduates enrolled for 12+ months at a university in the US, Canada, UK or Ireland, whatever their citizenship. You must still be an undergraduate during the internship. Placements announced Feb–Mar 2027.

countryNotes.PK: Not open to students at universities in Pakistan; only to those enrolled in the US, Canada, UK or Ireland.

name: Summer@EPFL Research Internship
host: EPFL School of Computer & Communication Sciences
amount: Living allowance (CHF 1,800/month on an older page; confirm) + travel refund
note: For students from other universities; you must still be enrolled during the internship. Faculty offers come about 4–6 weeks after the deadline.

name: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship
host: ETH Zurich, Department of Computer Science
amount: CHF 4,000 stipend + travel and visa costs (2 Jul – 27 Aug 2027)
note: For BSc/MSc students at other universities who graduate in 2028 or later. Notified by end of Feb 2027.
